# optimizelycmssaas_application (Resource)

A CMS application: a website (or remote website) with an entry point and hosts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "optimizelycmssaas_application" "site" {
  key          = "MainSite"
  display_name = "Main site"
  type         = "website"
  entry_point  = optimizelycmssaas_content.start.reference

  hosts = [
    { authority = "www.example.com", type = "primary", locale = "en", preferred_url_scheme = "https" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the CMS.
- `entry_point` (String) Reference to the start page content, e.g. cms://content/<id>.
- `key` (String) Unique key. Cannot be changed.
- `type` (String) website or inProcessWebsite. Cannot be changed.

### Optional

- `hosts` (Attributes List) Hosts assigned to the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosts))
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default application. Defaults to false.
- `preview_url_formats` (Map of String) Preview URL formats keyed by content type base or key. The server supplies a default when unset.
- `use_application_specific_assets` (Boolean) Whether the application uses a dedicated assets folder.
- `use_preview_tokens` (Boolean) Only applicable when type is website.

### Read-Only

- `assets_root` (String) Root of the application-specific assets, when enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosts`

Required:

- `authority` (String) DNS host name or IP with optional port.

Optional:

- `locale` (String) Locale associated with this host.
- `preferred_url_scheme` (String) http or https.
- `type` (String) default, primary, preview, redirectPermanent, redirectTemporary, edit or media.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import optimizelycmssaas_application.site MainSite
```
